name.en: Mohinga — A Morning in a Bowl
name.my: မုန့်ဟင်းခါး

teaser.zh: 一碗魚湯米線，盛著香氣、早餐的忙碌，以及不同家庭記憶中的味道。
teaser.en: A bowl of rice noodles and fragrant fish broth carries more than breakfast.
teaser.my: မုန့်ဟင်းခါးသည် မြန်မာ့ရိုးရာအစားအစာများထဲမှ လူသိများသော အစားအစာဖြစ်သည်။

story.zh: 清晨的攤位漸漸熱鬧，熱湯澆上細米線，再撒上各式配料。有人喜歡炸豆餅的酥脆，有人喜歡湯底的濃郁。Mohinga 是許多人熟悉的味道，也是地方食譜各有變化的料理。
story.en: As the morning stalls stir to life, hot broth meets rice noodles and a choice of toppings. Some look for the crunch of fritters; others for the warmth of the broth. Mohinga is familiar to many, yet its recipes have room for local variation.

context.zh: Mohinga（မုန့်ဟင်းခါး）通常以米線搭配魚湯或香料湯底，常見配料有炸物、香草或其他地方習慣的食材。它經常與早餐聯想在一起，但不只限於早晨享用；各地做法不同。
context.en: Mohinga (မုန့်ဟင်းခါး) generally pairs rice noodles with a savory, often fish-based broth. Fritters, herbs and other toppings vary by place and preference. It is strongly associated with breakfast but is enjoyed beyond the morning as well.

moments.zh: 同一道料理，可以有不同地區的湯底與配料。
moments.en: A shared dish, with regional approaches to broth and toppings.

moments.zh: 炸物的酥脆感，常與熱湯形成鮮明對比。
moments.en: Crispy fritters offer a contrast to the warm broth.

moments.zh: 認識一個地方，有時可以從日常的一碗早餐開始。
moments.en: Food can be an intimate entry point into everyday culture.

note.zh: 文化也許就是那道讓人想起家的味道。
note.en: Sometimes, a sense of place begins with a familiar flavor.
